concerns.text: T007 (Checksum Verify) and T008a/b (Data Ingestion) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but have a strict dependency on T009 (Contract Schemas). T009 is listed as a foundational task but appears *after* T007 in the list, and T008a explicitly depends on T009. If T007 runs before T009, it cannot validate against the schema. If T008a runs before T009, it fails. The [P] tag is invalid here; these tasks must be sequenced after T009.

T014 (Traditional Descriptors) is marked [P] and depends on T008a. T017 (Merge Features) depends on T014 and T016. However, T016 (TDA Vectors) depends on T013, which depends on T012. The dependency chain for T017 is T017 -> T016 -> T013 -> T012 -> T005/T006. T014 -> T008a -> T009. T017 requires the *output* of T014 (Traditional) and T016 (TDA). While T014 and T016 can run in parallel, T017 is a consumer of both. The current ordering lists T014 before T012/T013, which is fine, but the [P] tag on T014 implies it has no dependencies on the TDA pipeline, which is true, but the grouping in Phase 3 mixes parallel-safe tasks with sequential dependencies (T012->T013->T016). The 'Parallel Opportunities' section claims 'All Foundational tasks marked [P] can run in parallel', but T007/T008 depend on T009, breaking this claim.

T008a (Data Ingestion Part 1) and T008b (Data Ingestion Part 2) are split into two tasks. T008b depends on T008a. However, T008a is marked [P]. T008a cannot be parallel-safe if it is a prerequisite for T008b which is in the same logical block, unless T008b is also marked [P] and they are truly independent. But T008b explicitly depends on T008a. The [P] tag on T008a is misleading if it implies it can run concurrently with T008b in a way that doesn't require T008a to finish first. More critically, T008a depends on T009 (Schemas), but T009 is listed *after* T007 and *before* T008a in the text, yet T007 is also marked [P] and depends on T001a. The ordering of T009 relative to T007 is ambiguous in the list structure, risking T007 running before schema generation.

T015b is marked [P] and depends on T004 and T012. T012 is the TDA computation task. T015b implements sparse matrix logic in `persistence_utils.py`. If T012 depends on `persistence_utils.py` (which it likely does, as T006 is the foundational utils task), then T015b (modifying utils) must precede T012. However, T015b is listed *after* T012, T013, T014, T016. This is a critical ordering violation: T015b modifies a utility library that T012 consumes. T012 cannot run successfully if T015b (the fix/feature) hasn't been implemented yet. T015b must be moved to Phase 2 or immediately before T012.
